routes.note: Multi-file prototype: each page is its own .dc.html; no hash router. Query variants: Product ?id= ?sub=1 ?flavour=; Shop ?filter=; Gifts ?occasion=; SignIn ?mode=register|forgot ?next=checkout; Account ?tab= ?order=.

other_sc_ifs.note: session = depends on whether the visitor is signed in (MM.account), set on another page; content = stored data variants.

unresolved.reason: Express pay, Find address, discount Apply and the WhatsApp card stay inert in the draft; README states what each becomes.
SignIn accepts any password for an existing or demo account, and the reset link is simulated. WooCommerce My Account handles real authentication and reset tokens.
